13:- **Tools from pi-durable extensions.** Extensions such as [pit](https://github.com/cv/pit) add tools. When a tool asks a question, pi-action posts it on the issue, and an answer starts a new run. See [Extensions](docs/extensions.md).
14:- **Pull request context.** On a pull request, the first prompt includes the diff and the existing review comments.
76:| `github_token` | GitHub token for the API (issues, pull requests, reactions, comments). The agent's tools also get it as `GH_TOKEN` (see [Security](docs/security.md#the-agents-github-token-and-git-identity)) | Yes | - |
102:| `worktree_snapshot_exclude` | Globs (as in `.gitignore`) of untracked files never to save in a snapshot, one per line or comma-separated, for example `.env*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*`. Ignored files are never saved | No | - |
103:| `prompt_template` | Template for the first message of a new thread (see [Prompts](docs/prompts.md#custom-templates)) | No | (built-in prompt) |
105:| `prompt` | Task for the agent. Without `pr_number`, it needs `output_mode: output` (see [Workflow recipes](docs/workflows.md#output-mode-and-direct-prompts)) | No | - |
